named_gap.basis: the archive's last TRADE is the deadline day; other archive transaction types run to the last archive transaction date; the first 2026 snapshot transaction starts the next observed period. Nothing observes a trade between them.

rules: draft slots only from MFL slot tokens and MFL draft results
a scheduled slot is SELECTED, FORFEITED (a known forfeiture from a named provenance, no player), UNRESOLVED or a MISSING_SOURCE_RECORD: an absence is never called a forfeiture without a source
a trade is one package: nothing is credited to a single asset of a multi-asset trade
a future pick is never CONFIRMED to a slot; INFERRED only by UNIQUE_HOLDER_V1 with a complete inventory and observed custody
production is a sum over verified possession periods per franchise, never attributed to a pick or a trade
scope.source: committed archive through the guarded reader; no snapshot trade, no 2026 record
